title: Passage BIO, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: Passage Bio, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 20, 2026, disclosing updated interim Phase 1/2 clinical data for PBFT02 gene therapy in frontotemporal dementia (FTD-GRN), FDA feedback requiring a randomized controlled registrational trial design, and initiation of a strategic alternatives review with Wedbush PacGrow as financial advisor. The source is a biotech corporate filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: PBFT02-treated patients with CDR score 1 showed 64% reduction in whole brain atrophy and 54% reduction in frontotemporal cortex atrophy at 12 months versus natural history.
Dose 1 PBFT02 increased CSF progranulin from below 3 ng/mL at baseline to mean of 22.8 ng/mL at 12 months and 24.2 ng/mL at 18 months.
Plasma NfL levels showed average reduction of 1.0 pg/mL at 12 months in treated patients versus increase of 13.5 pg/mL in untreated natural history patients.
FDA indicated a randomized controlled registrational study design is required for PBFT02 in FTD-GRN indication.
Company initiated strategic alternatives review which may include merger, acquisition, asset sale, or licensing; Wedbush PacGrow engaged as financial advisor.
Two prior asymptomatic SAEs (venous sinus thrombosis, hepatotoxicity) reported in Dose 1 patients; no new treatment-related SAEs since previous update.
